correctness.rationale: For iid Bernoulli(p), n>=3, r mod3, the exact residue mass A_r(n)=[1+2Re(omega^{-r}(q+p omega)^n)]/3 is strictly positive. Conditioning gives C=p^2(A_{r-2}(n-2)A_r(n)-A_{r-1}(n-1)^2)/A_r(n)^2. Direct root-of-unity algebra cancels nonconjugate Fourier square, producing the submitted formula 3p²q²rho^{n-2}(2cos phi-rho^{n-2})/[1+2rho^n cos(n theta-2pi r/3)]². The denominator tends to one and rho<1; rational angles with denominator >=4 have both cosine signs per period, irrational angles equidistribute; for irrational theta/(2pi) the normalized empirical law is arcsine with sign densities 1/2. p→theta strictly monotone. For p=1/2, rho=1/2, theta=pi/3 yields strict six-periodic sign pattern from n=3. Independently checked fair n=3..26 all residues and 144 exact nonfair fraction/cyclotomic comparisons at 4 biases, n=3..14.
